title: Article 343 — Official language of the Union

content.overview: Article 343 provides that the official language of the Union shall be Hindi in Devanagari script, and the form of numerals for official purposes of the Union shall be the international form of Indian numerals. Notwithstanding this, English shall continue to be used for all official purposes of the Union for which it was being used immediately before commencement, for a period of fifteen years (and thereafter as Parliament may by law provide). Parliament may by law provide for the use of the Devanagari form of numerals and for the continued use of English after the fifteen-year period.
content.glance: Union official language: Hindi (Devanagari). English continued for Union official purposes (initially 15 years; continued by parliamentary law). International form of Indian numerals.
content.study:
Article 343:
(1) Official language of the Union: Hindi in Devanagari script; numerals: international form of Indian numerals.
(2) English continued for Union official purposes for 15 years from commencement (and as Parliament provides thereafter).
(3) Parliament may provide for Devanagari numerals and for continued use of English.

The Official Languages Act and related law implement continued bilingual use for Union purposes.

Examination: Hindi as official language; English continuance; numerals; parliamentary regulation.

sections.heading: Key rules
sections.body:
1. Official language of the Union: Hindi in Devanagari script.
2. Numerals: international form of Indian numerals.
3. English continued for Union official purposes (15-year transitional period; thereafter as Parliament provides).
